text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- British and French ambassadors and head of the Greek liason office in Skopje handed over to the Macedonian Prime minister Branko Crvenkovski a declaration expressing concern over inter-ethnic relations in the country and supporting government efforts to resolve the problems.
- Justice Minister Vlado Popovski says the scandal in the savings bank TAT from Bitola indicates "severe forms of organised crime in Macedonia."

- Macedonian National Bank governor Borko Stanoevski refuses to resign. He appeals on citizens with saving deposits to be patient and allow auditors to do their work. TAT operated with three lists of depositors placing famous personalities on a "secret list".

- Leader of opposition IMPRO-DPMNY Ljupco Georgievski asks students to stop their hunger strike. He announced different forms of demonstrations against the SDAM-run government. -- Skopje newsroom +389 91 201 196
